div.div:
الرَّاجِفَةُ , in the Kur lxxix. 6, means The first blast [of the horn on the day of resurrection]: and الرَّادِفَةُ, in the next verse, “ the second blast: ” (O, Bd, Jel, K:) or the former means the motionless bodies that shall be in a state of violent motion
at the time here spoken of, such as the earth and the mountains; because of the saying in the Kur [lxxiii. 14], يَوةمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ: and the latter, “ the heaven, and the stars, which shall be cleft and scattered. ” (Bd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
